svg.title: AIcoach — Landing (tray and sheets)

text.tspan: Film one swing down the line at the range. AIcoach
names the fault, shows how sure it is, and gives you
one drill and one mobility exercise.
For golfers between +2 and 15 handicap who practise
at the range with a phone. A practice tool, not for rounds.

extension, and I’m sure of it.

svg.text: One thread. Everything else slides up.
The coach’s answer is the page. Evidence, practice and questions wait below it, one swipe away.
One swing fits inside a range session.

text.tspan: From behind, along the target line.
Phone at hand height, 2.4–3.7 m away.
One clip, mp4 or mov, up to 15 s.
Nothing is kept unless you ask.

thing to practise before the next ball.

If your swing shows something else, the coach says “No verified fault found”. It does not force one.

Your coach is waiting for one swing.
Create an account, film a down-the-line clip, and read the answer at the range.
Unsaved clips are deleted after analysis. Delete your account any time.
AIcoach is a practice tool, not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
